title: Cryptanalytic Use of Statistical Invariant Attacks
summary: A probabilistic generalization of invariant attacks is identified, but its cryptanalytic usefulness remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether statistical invariant attacks---generalizations of invariant attacks that work only with a certain probability rather than for all possible plaintexts---can be made cryptanalytically useful.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptanalysis of statistical invariant attacks.
parameters: the probability that the attack works
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether statistical invariant attacks can be made cryptanalytically useful.

citations.label: Proving Resistance Against Invariant Attacks: How to Choose the Round Constants

progress.summary: The source presents this as future work and asks whether statistical invariant attacks can be used cryptanalytically. It notes that the question had already been raised previously.
citation_labels: Christof Beierle et al., Proving Resistance Against Invariant Attacks: How to Choose the Round Constants
